title: Understanding Linearly Separable Datasets
text: In a linearly separable dataset, there exists a hyperplane that can perfectly separate the data points of different classes. Think about how this might affect the accuracy of a classifier.

title: Logistic Regression and Linearly Separable Data
text: Logistic regression can find a decision boundary that separates the classes in a linearly separable dataset. Consider what this means for the model's performance.

title: Evaluating Classifier Accuracy
text: If a dataset is linearly separable, can a classifier achieve 100% accuracy?
